# Logbook Plus

> Logbook Plus is an enterprise-grade financial intelligence, expense tracking, and campus fee ledger platform designed for modern academic institutions, organizations, and professionals.

Logbook Plus streamlines double-entry record keeping, multi-tenant academic departmental ledgers, real-time fee reconciliation, automated dispute ticketing, and zero-knowledge encrypted backups. It provides cross-platform access across web portals, dedicated subdomains (Master Admin Console, IT Helpdesk), and native Android applications.

## Core Features & Architecture

- **Multi-Tenant Academic Finance**: School-isolated ledger management with custom fee categories, term auditing, and student accounts.
- **Enterprise Helpdesk & Ticketing**: Dedicated sub-system for customer support, automatic Telegram bot escalations, and SLA tracking.
- **Master Super-Admin Console**: Centralized license keys, domain health telemetry, live user session monitoring, and audit logs.
- **Client Guard & Security**: User-agent enforcement, TOTP 2-Factor Authentication, PBKDF2/AES-GCM encrypted cloud backups, and WebDAV sync.
- **Cross-Platform Ecosystem**: High-performance React web client, Express REST API backend, and native Android application with offline-first local storage.

- [Pricing](https://logbookplus.co.in/pricing): Tiered plans for single users, departments, and enterprise educational institutions.
- [About Us](https://logbookplus.co.in/about): Mission, security posture, and background of the Logbook Plus engineering team.
- [Web Application Login](https://logbookplus.co.in/app): Authentication portal for institutional accountants, staff, and administrators.
- [IT Helpdesk Portal](https://helpdesk.logbookplus.co.in/): Dedicated ticketing and customer service portal for institutional issues and ticket tracking.
- [Changelog](https://logbookplus.co.in/changelog): Continuous product updates, bug fixes, and feature releases.
- [Documentation](https://logbookplus.co.in/documentation): Cryptographic specifications, SQLite storage engine, WebDAV sync, and developer APIs.
- [Community](https://logbookplus.co.in/community): Community channels, GitHub open source repositories, and security bug bounty disclosures.
- [Blog](https://logbookplus.co.in/blog): Financial engineering articles, institution bookkeeping best practices, and release deep-dives.
- [Help Center & FAQ](https://logbookplus.co.in/help-center): Guides for setup, backup restoration, fee structure configuration, and user permissions.
- [Careers](https://logbookplus.co.in/careers): Open engineering, design, and operations roles at Logbook Plus.
- [Contact Sales & Support](https://logbookplus.co.in/contact): Direct contact channels, sales inquiries, and support email.
